Every state inspectable. 01 Global chrome and Build flyout 02 Type, actions and links 03 Composition archetypes 04 Image and media carriers 05 Strategic decision continuum 06 WorkGraph record 07 Factory build progression 08 One capability, two surfaces 09 Proof, provenance and conversion 10 Assessment close and footer COMPONENT 01 · GLOBAL CHROME An adaptive system, not a purchased mega-menu. Most routes remain direct. Build earns a flyout because it has real depth. The panel adapts to content and preserves ordinary links. Header grounds The header at the top of this page is the live instance: it adapts to ink over the ink close, hides on down-scroll and collapses at 940 px. The two frames below are rendered specimens of the same component classes, held inert so they add no second tab stop. Geist decides and structures. Newsreader judges and explains. JetBrains Mono is reserved for genuine metadata, never body copy and never decorative code. SCALE · 1440 / 390 / 320 H1 68 / 44 / 42 · 1.02 · 17 words H2 52 / 36 / 34 · 1.07 · 3 lines H3 32 / 27 / 26 · 1.12 · conclusion LEAD 23 / 20 / 19 · 1.44 · 42 words BODY 18 / 17 / 17 · 1.62 · 560–620 px META 13 / 12 / 12 · 1.42 · never below 12 H1 · GEIST Choose what stays human. LEAD · NEWSREADER We map how work actually moves, then choose what to preserve, simplify, automate, rebuild or retire. The smallest justified intervention wins. BODY · GEIST WorkGraph keeps the workflow, evidence, decisions, exceptions and controls behind an intervention in one company-specific context layer. The same record informs strategy, the Factory build and what happens in operation. METADATA · JETBRAINS MONO decision.status human_review_required context.version company_record_034 Actions look like actions. No pills. No ambiguous labels. Links remain visibly links. Every target is at least 44 by 44 px. The rest and focus-visible rows below are live controls; hover and active are held open for inspection. WARM GROUND FOCUS RING: INK REST Start an assessment See the decision model HOVER (HELD) Start an assessment See the decision model ACTIVE (HELD) Start an assessment See the decision model FOCUS-VISIBLE (HELD) Start an assessment See the decision model TEXT LINK Explore Transformation INK GROUND FOCUS RING: PAPER REST Start an assessment Inspect the operating record HOVER (HELD) Start an assessment Inspect the operating record ACTIVE (HELD) Start an assessment Inspect the operating record FOCUS-VISIBLE (HELD) Start an assessment Inspect the operating record TEXT LINK Explore Impact COMPONENT 03 · COMPOSITION Twelve columns. Editorial asymmetry. Mobile recomposed. Three opening compositions and seven shared section archetypes, all inside one system. These are layout variants, not three brands, and none of them is a finished page. Three openings A · STRATEGIC EDITORIAL 7 / 5 · BOUNDED DECISION FIELD THE STRATEGIC DECISION A company moves at the speed of its handoffs. Machines can execute continuously. A company still slows where context, ownership and decisions must be reconstructed by hand. START AN ASSESSMENT SEE THE DECISION MODEL B · PRODUCT MECHANISM CONCLUSION ABOVE ONE CARRIER FROM DECISION TO EXECUTION The decision becomes a build with a boundary. C · OPERATIONAL CONSEQUENCE CONCLUSION + GOVERNED STATE + PROVENANCE HUMAN CONTROL Execution is not complete until it runs within bounds. BOUNDARY TRIGGERED DRAFT WITHHELD OWNER FINANCE OWNER ILLUSTRATIVE OPERATING RECORD · CONSTRUCTED EXAMPLE Seven section archetypes Every archetype below is drawn with the real grid and the real rhythm tokens, so an opening can flow into any of them without a new token or a one-off rule. 01 Short punctuation 240–360 px · one conclusion · no media 02 Mechanism split 4 / 8 · spec rail beside one mechanism 03 Product stage 45 / 55 · conclusion beside one carrier 04 Dominant proof, narrow rail ≈3 / 1 · proof leads, rail annotates 05 Contained operational act One ink instrument inside the warm field 06 Impact evidence split Named consequence beside its provenance 07 Assessment close 5 / 7 · ink ground · one action RHYTHM RULES No two image-heavy acts may follow one another. A complete Home direction may use at most three ground changes and at most two Operational Evidence instruments. Section rhythm is 160 / 112 / 88 px for a large act and 112 / 88 / 64 px for a medium act, desktop to mobile. COMPONENT 04 · MEDIA CARRIERS The visual hierarchy is intentionally unequal. Decision Field is the world. Operational Evidence is the proof. Machine Signal is the restrained transition language. One component never carries all three. Home hero carrier · protected crops DESKTOP · PROTECTED 16:10 1586 × 992 · 102 KB WEBP Unresolved context, one coral decision and one sage boundary are all complete inside this frame. Nothing in the chain depends on a crop. MOBILE · ART-DIRECTED 4:5 960 × 1200 · 53 KB WEBP A separate re-staging at 4:5, not the desktop frame centre-cropped: the paths, the decision and the boundary were recomposed for the portrait field. Decision Field carrier One coral intervention changes which path may continue. Company context begins as imperfect evidence. Human judgment changes its course. Governance gives it a boundary. Engineering resolves it into a precise operating system. LANGUAGE Decision Field · world CORAL One human decision per frame SAGE Boundary or stable state only SLOT Strategic act · 3:2 · bounded Decision Field · direction A portfolio · 3:2 above 768 px, art-directed 4:5 below it. A generative grammar, not a fixed asset. LANGUAGE BOUNDARY This act carries the world and its transition only. The contained Operational Evidence carrier is the next act, on its own ground, because one section never uses all three languages. Page-level ranges — Paper 55–60% · Lift 15–20% · Ink 15–20% · Coral 4–6% · Sage 2–4% — and the 70 / 25 / 5 distribution apply to composed full-page directions, not to this catalog. COMPONENT 05 · MACHINE SIGNAL Resolution is the narrative. A short, finite transition where machine speed or resolution is the meaning. Never a page world, never an ambient background, never a second hero language. CONTROL One shot, then removed PASS 900 ms · once · then stops CHANGES Position, width and opacity only CORAL Once, at the judgment stratum SAGE Only when the boundary verifies REPLAY None — the pass is under one second REDUCED MOTION The resolved state, immediately The resolved state is the document default, so the strata are never left coarse without JavaScript or under reduced motion. Nothing here is applied to the protected hero photograph: no filter, blur or overlay stands in for the transition. COARSE SIGNAL → RESOLVED RECORD Resolve the record CONTEXT OBSERVED SOURCES ALIGNED JUDGMENT APPLIED BOUNDARY VERIFIED RECORD RESOLVED COARSE SIGNAL · ONE RESOLUTION AVAILABLE COMPONENT 06 · CONTAINED PROOF Proof is a state change, not a dashboard. Operational Evidence is one contained, inspectable operational event. It never pretends to be a live interface, a customer result or a deployed system. ONE OPERATIONAL EVENT The invoice and the goods receipt disagree. The prepared draft is withheld from release. REGISTERED Purchase order, goods receipt, invoice, payment policy JUDGMENT The Finance owner confirms the exception BOUNDARY No release proceeds; the item returns for source correction ILLUSTRATIVE OPERATING RECORD · CONSTRUCTED EXAMPLE · NOT A CLIENT DEPLOYMENT LANGUAGE Operational Evidence · contained proof SURFACE Ink instrument · 14 px radius SCALE Contained inside the warm field, never full bleed PER DIRECTION At most two instruments It supports evidence; it does not manufacture it. No client, engagement, outcome or amount is identified. COMPONENT 05 · STRATEGIC DECISION The first decision is what not to automate. We map how work actually moves, then choose what to preserve, simplify, automate, rebuild or retire. The smallest justified intervention wins. FIVE OUTCOMES, FROM KEEPING THE WORK TO STOPPING IT KEEP THE WORK STOP THE WORK 01 Preserve 02 Simplify 03 Automate 04 Rebuild 05 Retire Keep the work as it is. CHOOSE WHEN The work is proportionate to its value, and human judgment is essential. DO NOT CHOOSE WHEN Delay, rework or unclear ownership is quietly compounding. PROOF MARKER: HUMAN JUDGMENT REMAINS THE VALUE. A recommendation is not complete until it names an owner and the evidence that would change it. COMPONENT 06 · WORKGRAPH RECORD The map becomes part of the system. WorkGraph keeps the workflow, evidence, decisions, exceptions and controls behind an intervention in one company-specific context layer. ONE RETAINED RECORD Supplier payment exception REPRESENTATIVE WORKGRAPH RECORD · SYNTHETIC DATA APPROVED SOURCES Meetings Messages Documents Systems MEETINGS SOURCE Weekly operations review CAPTURED STATE Invoice and receipt disagree; release is awaiting review. EVIDENCE Review note linked to the purchase order and the invoice RETAINED · UNCHANGED BY SOURCE WORK Payment exception: resolve the mismatch before release DECISION Automate preparation; preserve human approval for release OWNER Finance owner BOUNDARY The agent prepares; only the Finance owner releases Retained context makes the next record clearer. Decision Field context carrier · smaller than the record it explains. Each decision, evaluation and operating record can strengthen the next intervention. Models can change; company context and learning need not restart from zero. COMPONENT 07 · FACTORY PROGRESSION The decision becomes a build with a boundary. Dagg Factory turns the intervention into an agent or software with the context, tools, permissions and evaluations needed to act within the decision. One 6–8 second pass. It holds at judgment and at verification, then stops in an inspectable resolved state. Under reduced motion the same end state appears immediately. PASS 7.2 s · one only HOLDS Product decision · Evaluation CONTROLS Pause motion · Replay NO JAVASCRIPT All six stages readable, no controls PROVENANCE Illustrative Factory build plan Illustrative Factory build plan · not a client deployment. FACTORY BUILD RECORD Prepare the payment draft. Preserve human approval for release. PAUSE MOTION REPLAY 01 Requirement Prepare the payment draft from approved sources; keep release with a person. 02 Product decision HOLD · JUDGMENT Automate preparation; preserve human approval for release. 03 Architecture Approved finance-system read and payment-draft tool. Prepare only; never release. 04 Build The purchase order, goods receipt, invoice and payment policy become the working context. 05 Evaluation HOLD · VERIFICATION When source records disagree, the draft is withheld and the exception is routed to the Finance owner. 06 Review Release owner: Finance owner. Way back: disable the agent, remove the draft, return the item to the manual queue. RESOLVED STATE Requirement linked to the company record COMPONENT 08 · ONE CAPABILITY, TWO SURFACES AI-native changes how the company works — and how customers work with it. Inside the company, agents carry stable execution while people direct, decide and verify. Outside it, the same governed capability can meet customers wherever they work. Inside the company At the customer surface ILLUSTRATIVE CAPABILITY · SYNTHETIC DATA · NOT A CLIENT DEPLOYMENT AT THE CUSTOMER SURFACE · ACCESS ONLY REQUEST What needs attention, and what can be resolved now? CONNECTION MCP exposes approved tools and permissioned context. AUTHORITY The client system remains the source of truth. ACTION Explain, prepare or execute only within the granted boundary. BOUNDARY No external write or commitment without accountable approval. EVIDENCE The same permission check and owner return to the same record. NEUTRAL REQUEST THE SAME GOVERNED CONTEXT SOURCE-GROUNDED RESPONSE PERMISSIONED ACTION THE SAME UPDATED RECORD Reached through the customer's own tools — a native product surface, or an assistant or coding surface the customer already uses. The interface is an access surface only.
